mcp_tools.name: local_voice_stack_engineering_pack
mcp_tools.title: Local voice stack engineering pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a local voice-stack engineering record (pipeline and engine selection, cloning consent and ethics, audio engineering and latency, accessibility, testing and quality gates) and returns a deterministic LOCAL_VOICE_STACK_SOUND / LOCAL_VOICE_STACK_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed per-engine license, golden-evaluation and cloning-consent checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it processes no audio.

inputSchema.description: The local voice stack engineering pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

engines.description: Declared engines: {name, license_cleared_for_commercial_use, evaluated_on_own_golden_sentences, is_voice_cloning, cloning_consent_recorded}.

expect.notes: All fields present and valid. computed_spot_checks: engines_count=1, license_coverage=1.000000, golden_evaluation_coverage=1.000000
